solution_summary: As a provider of in-store media solutions, Mood Media serves customers of all sizes, from top retailers and hotels to small businesses. The company has grown significantly since it was founded in 2004, but the legacy provider hosting its Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) was no longer able to keep pace. With the help of Apps Associates LLC (Apps Associates), an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner , it successfully migrated Oracle EBS, Oracle Business Intelligence, and Oracle APEX to AWS in 6 months. It used Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC), which lets companies define and launch AWS resources in a logically isolated virtual network, to establish a connection with Mood Media’s legacy data center and migrate 11 TB of enterprise data to AWS. Apps Associates optimized Mood Media’s enterprise workloads, mapped them onto AWS, and identified ways to run existing Oracle applications.

It used Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC), which lets companies define and launch AWS resources in a logically isolated virtual network, to establish a connection with Mood Media’s legacy data center and migrate 11 TB of enterprise data to AWS.

Amazon Redshift , which provides outstanding price performance for cloud data warehousing, was chosen as a data lake for enterprise resource planning systems. “On AWS, Mood Media can run Oracle with excellent price performance, speed, and efficiency,” says Patel. “The company sees great business value and decreased time to market that it couldn’t achieve with legacy infrastructure.” Previously, Mood Media had multiple outages every quarter; in the 16 months since the migration, it experienced only one 15-minute outage.
With its Amazon Redshift data lake, Mood Media has reliable access to enterprise data, which it can use to visualize insights and guide business decisions.
The total cost of ownership has also decreased; instead of spending thousands of dollars on a dedicated environment, Mood Media can spin up development and production instances as needed.
